description: Level, IR remote, audio, radio, camera, clock, calculator and more

store.summary: 13 tools on the Zero's own sensors: level, IR remote, audio, radio, camera, more
store.description: Tools turns the CardputerZero's own hardware into thirteen pocket instruments behind one icon grid: a bubble level, angle finder and compass on the IMU; an IR remote that learns keys from any remote and sends them back; a sound meter, spectrum, tuner and recorder on the microphone; a list of nearby Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices; a camera with a live viewfinder and a QR reader; a shake and impact meter; a clock with a timer and a stopwatch; a metronome; a calculator; a hand counter; a key tester; a flashlight; and battery, memory and brightness at a glance. Every screen is driven by the keyboard (F/X/Z/C move, Enter acts, Esc goes back, / searches), Tab changes the size of the icon grid, and every move animates. Built with PocketJS; source at https://github.com/pocket-nexus/pocket-zero-tools.
